mapper.select: SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_user_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_color, t.tag_created_at, COALESCE(fc.cnt, 0) AS file_count, COALESCE(foc.cnt, 0) AS folder_count FROM pcd_tag_table t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ft.ft_tag_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pcd_file_tag_table ft INNER JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON ft.ft_file_id = f.file_id WHERE ft.ft_target_type = 'file' AND GROUP BY ft.ft_tag_id ) fc ON t.tag_id = fc.ft_tag_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ft.ft_tag_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pcd_file_tag_table ft INNER JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON ft.ft_node_id = d.node_id WHERE ft.ft_target_type = 'folder' AND GROUP BY ft.ft_tag_id ) foc ON t.tag_id = foc.ft_tag_id WHERE t.tag_user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} ORDER BY t.tag_created_at DESC
